title: Bound the physical Galaxy camera log-distance in both wheel directions

scope.subject: Clamp only excessive proposed frame progress along the existing captured native YEIS logarithmic camera trajectory; add a trusted outward camera regression without changing input or path ownership.

research_summary: Exact V11 c4 upgrade 476e4558 CI build artifact 15121451959 (run 45829527163 attempt 2) passes all hosted checks and the inward <0.72 oracle, but a trusted +120 notch from opening Galaxy scale 0.250 to 0.000 advances 0.870525 of physical logarithmic span in its first 45ms-delayed R3F paint. Three MutationObserver trials captured every native applied write and left requested scale/pose untouched. Exact main 3d9fd529 CI dist artifact 15109169088 jumps 1.000. Source: pinned CameraController.update evaluates smoothstep(galaxyScaleVisualResponse(scale)) then log-lerps d0/d1; replace no motion/authority, cap only the overly-large physical log displacement that the existing scalar damp failed to constrain.

sources.finding: Current pinned native renderer remains the authority; no upstream patch or new camera.
Installed MathUtils.damp interpolates using delta time with no internal queue or clock; pass the existing R3F frame delta.
Pinned native CameraController still owns the exact path: cubic smoothstep of normalized progress, then geometric interpolation of true radial distance between captured endpoints.
Use installed Playwright trusted wheel with direct native camera ratio observations for both directions; not a JS-only coordinate test.

search_ladder.conclusion: Reuse captured native YEIS travel and astronomical reference transfer; generic replacement wheel/camera product would lose authored near/far composition.
R3F continues to decide when the selected native pose is drawn; Three MathUtils smoothstep matches the existing pinned trajectory and damp clock.
Keep the same CameraController scrub geometry and exact endpoint/ownership signal. No second camera, update loop, or timer.
Cap the existing proposed product coordinate by its exact normalized physical log-distance, inverting only over the same monotonic path when the candidate exceeds the per-frame budget.

candidates.name: Existing Native YEIS Path With Log-Distance Frame Bound
candidates.source: Installed Three.js MathUtils plus native Galaxy frame in YeisGalaxyScene
candidates.license: Project code plus existing MIT camera dependency
candidates.reason: Uses the existing damp and smoothstep trajectory; caps only excessive actual log-distance movement, without changing input gain, regular fast frames, handoff poses or source authority.

candidates.name: Use camera-controls or timed autopilot instead
candidates.source: Existing close-world CameraControls and native YEIS timed navigation
candidates.reason: Wrong camera owner or returns to autonomous travel; duplicates manual scale authority. Neither fixes the physical log-distance jump of the reused native segment without duplicating or changing the trajectory.

decision.rationale: Bound actual physical displacement as a fraction of the remaining authored native path, not a separate timer/velocity/distance authority. Preserve existing imperceptible exact settle and match slow-runner bidirectional real camera benchmarks.
decision.fallback: Do not merge/deploy V11/V12 on a failing directional physical bound. Leave existing frame budgets, deadlines, resource tests and same-path acceptance untouched.
